location: At the entrance and inside the home of my parents in the North District of Xinmen Street Residential Area, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: An afternoon nap and replying to blessing messages.
description: Taking a nap on the couch under a blanket, replying to accumulated New Year greetings: sending a voice message to my best friend Li Meiling to arrange a meal, sending a text greeting to my friend Wang Jia, replying to regular customer Vivian’s invitation for post-holiday new arrivals; occasionally chatting with my mother about TV shows.
location: The sofa in the living room of my parents' home in the North District of Xinmen Street Community, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: In the evening, the whole family takes a stroll to reminisce about old times.
description: The family of five strolls through the street, with their daughter skipping ahead, the couple walking hand in hand, and the parents following behind. The father points out the old soy sauce shop that has now become a café, sighing at the changes. The husband captures a photo of the three of them from behind, bathed in the warm and peaceful glow of the setting sun.
location: The old streets and alleys around Xinmen Street and Zhongshan Road in Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Simple Dinner and Confirmation of Return Arrangements
description: Heating up leftovers and cooking plain congee for dinner. After the meal, had tea with my parents to confirm the return trip to Xiamen around 9 a.m. tomorrow. My mother reminded me to bring local specialties like Juhong Gao (tangerine peel cake) and Suanrong Zhi (garlic twist pastries) to share with friends.
location: Parents' home dining room and living room in Xinmen Street Residential Area, North District, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Plan for Post-Holiday Health and Work Matters
description: A brief meeting with my husband to confirm the appointment for the check-up at Jiangtou Street Community Health Service Center on February 10th and the flight and hotel information for the Guangzhou ordering conference on February 4th; my husband will contact to schedule a health check-up for our parents, ensuring it is quick and efficient without in-depth discussions.
location: Parents' bedroom in the North District of Xinmen Street Residential Area, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Personal grooming and packing return luggage.
description: Take a hot shower and complete the evening skincare routine, then methodically organize the suitcase: fold clothes, pack specialty foods prepared by parents such as orange-red cakes and Yuanhetang preserved fruits, and reserve space for the toiletry bag and outerwear.
location: Parents' bathroom and bedroom in the North District of Xinmen Street Residential Area, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Bedtime Parent-Child Reading Passes Down the Festive Spirit of the New Year
description: Reading the picture book "Reunion" with my daughter, I gently tell the story of returning home for the Spring Festival and love; my daughter asks about the return journey and gradually falls asleep in her mother's embrace.
location: Parents' bedroom in the North District of Xinmen Street Residential Area, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: After chatting with my parents about daily life, I went to bed.
description: In the living room, I refilled my parents' cups with water and chatted with them. My father reminded me to drive slowly, and Song Yajing invited my parents to stay in Xiamen when the weather gets warmer. I set the alarm for 7:30, turned off the lights around 22:00, and fell asleep with a heart full of family warmth and reluctance to leave.
location: Living room and bedroom of parents' home in the North District of Xinmen Street Community, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province.

name: Morning Awakening and Lying in Bed
description: Waking up in the bedroom of my parents’ home in Quanzhou, I see the gloomy sky outside the window. Listening to the faint sounds of my parents in the kitchen, a wave of reluctance washes over me. I linger in bed for a while, savoring the last bit of laziness in my childhood home.
location: Fujian Province, Quanzhou City, Licheng District, Xinmen Street Community, North District

name: Morning Brisk Walking in Zhongshan Park
description: Walk to the nearby Zhongshan Park and seize the pre-rain gap for a 30-minute brisk walk. The park still retains a festive atmosphere but is quiet now. By intermittently accelerating the pace, I break a light sweat, awaken my energy, and reinforce my holiday exercise routine.
location: Zhongshan Park, North Zhongshan Road, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Return home to wash up and do some simple tidying.
description: After a brisk walk, I returned home on foot, took a shower, and changed into loungewear. I saw my mother busy in the kitchen and my father watching the news. I began gathering scattered personal items next to the suitcase, preparing for my departure.
location: Xinmen Street Residential Area, North District, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Family Breakfast and Farewell Before Departure
description: Sharing a sumptuous Southern Min breakfast (vermicelli soup, fried dough sticks, etc.) prepared by my mother with my family, the atmosphere was warm yet tinged with melancholy as my mother repeatedly offered her advice. After the meal, my husband and I finally packed our luggage and got into the car, with the trunk filled to the brim with homemade food from my mother. At the entrance of the building, I hugged my parents tightly, repeatedly promising to reunite in the future, and watched their figures until the car turned the corner and disappeared from sight.
location: Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province, Xinmen Street Residential Area, North District

name: Driving back to Xiamen (first half of the journey)
description: Driving from my parents' home in Quanzhou, we entered the Shenhai Expressway via city roads. The weather turned overcast with light rain. Our daughter fell asleep in the car. My husband and I reminisced about our holiday conversations with my parents, sent a message to the family group to let them know we were safe, and looked through family photos.
location: Shenhai Expressway (Quanzhou to Xiamen direction)

name: Rest and Lunch at the Highway Service Area
description: We stopped for a break at Puli Service Area. My husband went to the restroom and refueled the car. I took our daughter to the convenience store to buy hot drinks, bread, and rice balls for a simple lunch, and we ate together in the car. I shared photos of the service area in our family group chat.
location: Puli Service Area (Shenyang Direction) on Shenyang-Haikou Expressway, Jinjiang City, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province, China

name: The latter half of the drive back home and arriving at the residence in Xiamen.
date: From 12:40:00 on January 31, 2025, to 14:20:00 on January 31, 2025
description: Continuing the journey from the service area, the rain gradually stopped, and my daughter played with her new toy in the car. In the afternoon, we arrived at the underground garage of the Shanggu Street community on Hubin South Road in Siming District, Xiamen, smoothly completing the transition from Quanzhou to our small family setting in Xiamen.
location: No. 128, Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Luggage Arrangement and Preliminary Home Cleaning
description: The family moved their luggage from the garage upstairs. After opening the windows to ventilate, they divided the tasks: the husband handled the heavy lifting, while Song Yajing vacuumed the living room and master bedroom and changed the bedsheets and duvet covers. Next, they sorted through the large amount of food brought back from Quanzhou. The cooked dishes that needed refrigeration were placed in airtight containers and stored in the refrigerator, while the ingredients with longer shelf lives were organized properly. In this way, the warmth of their hometown was seamlessly integrated into their daily space.
location: No. 128, Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China

name: Unwrapping gifts and family relaxation.
description: After the husband returned from playing with their daughter, the whole family opened the gifts brought back from Quanzhou (a new dress for the daughter, tea for the husband) and the local specialties packed by the parents. The daughter tried on the dress, the husband brewed the new tea, and Song Yajing organized the specialties to give to friends. They engaged in relaxed conversation, helping their daughter adjust to the transition from her grandparents' home back to her own.
location: No. 128, Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Prepare a simple family dinner.
description: Preparing dinner with ready-made ingredients brought back from Quanzhou: reheating the fried vinegar pork my mother made, stir-frying a plate of vegetables, and cooking a simple pot of rice cake soup. This not only solves dinner but also uses up the food I brought back, saving both time and effort. A brief prayer of gratitude before the meal.
location: No. 128, Shanggu Street Community, South Hubin Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Parent-child shared reading and bedtime washing.
description: After dinner, the husband takes charge of washing the dishes. Song Yajing spends time with her daughter, reading picture books brought back from Quanzhou and playing puzzles together. She then assists her daughter with bathing, brushing her teeth, and changing into pajamas, completing the bedtime routine. Finally, she tucks her daughter into bed and tells bedtime stories until she falls asleep.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Personal Hygiene and Baking Attempts
description: After quickly finishing my own washing up, I was suddenly inspired to slice the New Year cake my mother had given me, brush it with honey and butter, and bake it in the oven as a sweet transition back to daily life. While waiting, I tidied up the washstand.
location: No. 128, Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Check the Memorandum and Prepare Pragmatically
description: Take out the baked rice cake and let it cool. Carefully check the phone memo in the study to confirm that the next day (February 1st) is an adjustment day with no urgent matters. Then make specific preparations for the upcoming schedule: 1) Confirm and save the flight ticket and electronic boarding pass for the trip to Guangzhou on February 4th; 2) Check and set a reminder for the gynecological examination appointment on February 2nd; 3) Organize the procurement list and supplier materials needed for the Guangzhou order fair; 4) Prepare clothes for the daughter for the next day.
location: No. 128, Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Couple's Evening Communication and Relaxation
date: From 21:30:00 on January 31, 2025 to 22:40:00 on January 31, 2025
description: The husband came to the living room, and the two of them enjoyed roasted rice cakes and flower tea together. Song Yajing shared her preparations for the next few days, receiving her husband’s support and care. They briefly planned their activities for the next day (Saturday, a rest day), deciding to sleep in during the morning and possibly go to the park in the afternoon. Afterward, Song Yajing engaged in her personal bedtime relaxation routine, listening to soothing music and reading a novel, feeling a sense of calm and stability as she transitioned from the holiday reunion back to her daily routine.
location: No. 128 Hubin South Road, Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Fall asleep
date: From 22:40:00 on January 31, 2025, to 23:00:00 on January 31, 2025.
description: Gradually falling asleep in a calm and slightly weary state, storing up energy for the transition back to life after the Spring Festival holiday.
location: No. 128, Shanggu Street Community, Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Wake up, wash up, and morning preparation
description: The last day of the Spring Festival holiday began in the familiar morning light of an old city in southern Fujian. Song Yajing woke up, feeling slightly weary from the days of family gatherings, but the thought that today was the day of her return journey immediately cleared her mind. As she washed up, she looked into the mirror, organizing her thoughts and resolving to observe her parents more attentively today, and to discuss with her husband, Aqiang, a detailed plan for their future care.
location: XX West Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province, parents' home bedroom and bathroom

name: Having breakfast and warm conversations with parents.
description: Mother had prepared steaming hot vermicelli soup, fried dough sticks, and scrambled eggs. At the dining table, Song Yajing deliberately steered the conversation toward lighthearted family topics, asking her parents about their recent meals and community activities. She noticed that her father was eating slowly, while her mother kept adding food to her bowl, reminding her to be careful on the road. Suppressing the ache in her heart, she smiled and agreed, softly suggesting once again that they come to Xiamen for a short stay. Though her parents did not directly agree, their eyes revealed a sense of comfort.
location: Parents' Home Restaurant, No. XX, West Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: The final tidying up and careful inspection of household chores.
description: She took the initiative to clear the dishes. Afterward, under the pretense of "checking what the household still needed," she carefully inspected the family's medicine cabinet, noted down a few medications that were nearing their expiration dates, and discreetly placed a new bottle of Huoxue Zhitong plaster on the most visible spot on the living room coffee table. Then, she returned to the room she was temporarily staying in, where she made final adjustments and reinforced the luggage she had roughly packed the night before, along with the bag of local specialties her mother had stuffed to the brim, ensuring everything would be securely placed in the car later.
location: Parents' home living room and bedroom, No. XX, West Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Accompanying my mother to purchase fruits and return home.
description: At her mother's request, she accompanied her to the nearby West Street market to buy some fresh fruit for her daughter to take back to Xiamen. Walking along the familiar streets, her mother held her arm and chattered about the neighbors' trivial matters. Song Yajing listened patiently, carefully selecting apples, oranges, and cherry tomatoes at the fruit stall, and insisted on paying herself. Afterward, mother and daughter carried the fruit and walked back home, the journey filled with a reluctant warmth.
location: No. 210, West Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province, West Street Vegetable Market

name: Preparing Lunch and Final Companionship
description: Back home, Song Yajing tied on an apron and insisted on helping her mother prepare lunch. She took charge of washing and chopping the vegetables, while her mother handled the cooking. Her father sat in the living room, listening to Minnan opera. The aroma of braised pork ribs and ginger duck wafted from the kitchen. During a break, she pulled up the family photo album on her phone and watched recent videos of her granddaughter Xuanxuan with her mother. Their laughter momentarily eased the sorrow of parting.
location: Parents' home kitchen and living room, No. XX, West Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Reunion Lunch and Formal Farewell
description: Husband Chen Zhiqiang arrived on time from the hotel to pick them up. The family gathered around the table to enjoy a hearty lunch. Song Yajing made an effort to keep the atmosphere lively, sharing amusing stories about Xuanxuan’s experiences in kindergarten. After the meal, her parents repeatedly loaded the car with packed local specialties and fruits. At the doorstep, her mother’s eyes welled up with tears as she repeatedly reminded them to "drive safely" and "call when you arrive." Her father patted his son-in-law on the shoulder, saying little, but his eyes were filled with concern. Song Yajing hugged her parents, holding back tears as she got into the car.
location: Parents' Home Restaurant, No. XX, West Street, Licheng District, Quanzhou City, Fujian Province

name: Preliminary Discussion on Urban Driving and Highway Return Journey
description: The car slowly left the old town of West Street, passing through familiar streets as it headed toward the entrance of the Shenhai Expressway in Quanzhou. During the initial part of the journey, there was a somewhat heavy silence in the car. After merging onto the main highway, the traffic flowed smoothly. Song Yajing took a deep breath and turned to her husband, detailing the changes in her father’s physical strength and the fatigue her mother had unintentionally revealed. They exchanged views on the preliminary idea of "bringing their parents to Xiamen." The discussion shifted from emotional venting to a practical exploration of solutions.
location: Shenhai Expressway, Quanzhou to Xiamen section, inside the vehicle

name: Service Area Rest and In-depth Discussion
description: They parked and took a break at the Puli Service Area, using the restroom. The two bought coffee and sat in the lounge area. Away from the focus of driving, Song Yajing laid out the thoughts she had been pondering for days: the feasibility of bringing her parents to Xiamen, the types of housing to consider, the potential financial pressure, and whether hiring a part-time helper might be necessary to ease her mother’s burden. Chen Zhiqiang took out his phone’s memo app, listening while jotting down key points, and added information he knew about senior communities in Xiamen and the settlement of medical insurance across different regions.
location: Shenhai Expressway Puli Service Area

name: Continue the return journey and arrive in Xiamen.
description: After getting back on the road, the conversation came to a temporary pause. Song Yajing gazed out the window at the scenery rushing by, feeling slightly more settled than when they had set out. She took advantage of this time to search briefly on her phone for keywords like "Xiamen senior apartments" and "home visit family doctor," bookmarking useful links. The car entered Siming District in Xiamen around 5 p.m.
location: Shenhai Expressway Xiamen Section and roads within Xiamen City, inside the vehicle

name: Purchase ingredients and walk home.
description: The vehicle arrived in Xiamen and entered the Siming District. Song Yajing suggested stopping by their usual Yuánchū Food Store to pick up some groceries before heading home. She quickly selected a few ready-to-cook dishes, fresh milk, eggs, as well as a bag of high-gluten flour and yeast. After completing their shopping, the couple carried their bags and walked for about half an hour back to the Shànggǔ Street Community, located at 128 Hubin South Road.
location: No. 46 Houjiangdai Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, Yuanchu Food Store at the Ground Floor of Jiacheng Garden

name: Settling In at Home and Contacting the Store Staff
description: Returning to their long-unvisited home, the couple moved their luggage and local specialties into the house and tidied them up briefly. Song Yajing immediately made a phone call to Xiaomei, a shop assistant, speaking in a relaxed tone. She confirmed the key tasks for the next day, thus completing the event of "contacting the shop assistant to understand the store situation."
location: In the living room of Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Prepare and share a simple dinner together.
description: Using the semi-finished products they had bought and the ingredients available at home, Song Yajing and Chen Zhiqiang worked together and quickly prepared a dinner of three dishes and a soup. Meanwhile, their mother-in-law picked up their daughter, Xuanxuan, from a friend’s house. The family of three sat around the table for dinner, with Xuanxuan excitedly sharing her experiences playing at her grandmother’s friend’s house. The warm atmosphere of home gradually dispelled the fatigue from their journey.
location: In the kitchen and dining room of Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Video call parents to report safe arrival.
description: After dinner, the whole family video-called their parents in Quanzhou. Xuanxuan shouted "Grandpa, Grandma!" at the screen, while Song Yajing pointed the phone camera toward the dining table and living room, showing them, "We've arrived home safely and have already eaten." Seeing that everything was fine, their mother visibly relaxed, and their father smiled and nodded in the video.
location: In the living room of the Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Neighborhood Stroll and Planning Deepening
description: Leaving Xuanxuan in the care of her grandmother for a while, the couple went downstairs for a stroll in the neighborhood. The evening breeze was cool and refreshing as they walked slowly along the familiar path, continuing the conversation from the afternoon. Song Yajing mentioned wanting to consult the community health service center next week, and Chen Zhiqiang agreed, adding that they could start browsing housing listings online over the weekend. The walk turned into a moving "family meeting," deepening the "family discussion on the way back."
location: Internal walkways and central garden of Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Family Group Synchronization and Seeking Sister's Advice
description: After returning home from their walk, the two of them were together in the study. Song Yajing sent a long message in the "Happy Family" WeChat group, objectively describing the physical condition of their parents observed during this visit, as well as the three-step plan she and her husband had initially considered: "coming to Xiamen for a medical check-up, exploring residential options, and investigating care support." She specifically @-mentioned her sister, Song Yawen, seeking her support and analysis.
location: Home Study Room, Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Baking Preparation and Emotional Comfort
description: This is her own "healing time." She mixes the purchased high-gluten flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and other ingredients, adds warm milk and eggs, and begins kneading a basic bread dough. The process of kneading allows her to focus on the present moment, and the physical labor also eases her mental tension. Once the dough is kneaded, she covers it with plastic wrap and places it in the refrigerator for cold fermentation, ready for baking the next morning.
location: Home kitchen in Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Organizing, Reading, and Relaxing Before Bed
description: After finishing her washing up, she checked her phone and saw that her sister had replied in the family group chat, offering some suggestions. Song Yajing saved the link. Then, she reviewed the surveillance footage from the shop, prepared the clothes she would wear the next day and the documents she needed to bring to the store, placing them by the bedside. Finally, she briefly jotted down the keywords of the day in her diary. After that, leaning against the headboard under the warm light, she flipped through a few pages of a light-hearted novel, allowing her mind to drift away from the complexities of the day. About ten minutes later, feeling drowsiness set in, she turned off the light and went to rest.
location: Home bedroom in Shanggu Street Community, No. 128 Hubin South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Wake up and gentle morning activities
description: Awakened by the weekday biological clock, my body still feels the fatigue from the holiday. The planned morning brisk walk was abandoned due to muscle soreness and lack of energy, replaced by 15 minutes of yoga stretching in the living room to help my body wake up, while listening to my husband preparing breakfast in the kitchen.
location: Home bedroom and living room in Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (near South Hubin Road).

name: Family Breakfast Time
description: The family gathered around the table for breakfast, which included white porridge, fried eggs, and radish cakes brought back from Quanzhou. During the meal, we listened to our daughter share amusing stories from her holiday, checked her schoolbag, and confirmed that her handmade assignment was packed. The atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Home Dining Room in Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

name: Taking my daughter to school.
description: Holding my daughter's hand, we left home and traveled to Xiamen University Kindergarten using a combination of "walking + bus + walking" (approximately 25 minutes in total). At the kindergarten entrance, I handed her over to the teacher and watched her enter the campus.
location: From the home in Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, passing through the bus stop and bus, to Xiamen University Kindergarten at No. 422 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

location: From the bus stop at Xiamen University Kindergarten, No. 422 Siming South Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, take a bus to Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

During this time, Song Yajing shares pastries brought back from Quanzhou, and they chat casually about their holidays, creating a relaxed atmosphere.

The staff member, Xiaomei, was responsible for attending to customers.
location: "Elegant Wardrobe" store inside Ruijing Commercial Plaza, Zhongshan Road Pedestrian Street, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

Her sister agreed to help gather relevant information.

description: During the evening rush hour, I took the bus (approximately 50 minutes) to pick up my daughter from her kindergarten.

description: After picking up my daughter Xuanxuan, as per her request, we took a detour on foot to Yuanchu Food Store to purchase ingredients such as light cream and almond flour, planning to try making almond tuiles in the evening.

description: Her husband had already cooked the rice, and Song Yajing quickly stir-fried some dishes. The whole family then enjoyed dinner together, sharing stories about their day.
location: In the kitchen and dining room of the Shanggu Street residential area, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Parent-child interaction time
description: Spending time playing with my daughter, including doing puzzles and reading picture books, to make up for the missed opportunity of exercising together in the morning, and enjoying warm parent-child moments.

name: Evening Baking Attempt
description: Tying on an apron, I tried making almond tile cookies in the kitchen. My daughter watched curiously nearby, while my husband occasionally offered assistance. The entire process was both focused and therapeutic.
location: In the kitchen of the Shanggu Street residential area, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Taste the fruits and share with family.
date: From 21:30:00 on February 3, 2025, to 22:00:00 on February 3, 2025
description: Enjoy freshly baked almond tile cookies with my husband, and have a brief discussion about the plan to have a video conference with my sister over the weekend to thoroughly discuss our parents' elderly care arrangements. Afterwards, take care of some simple household chores.
location: In the living room of Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China.

name: Pre-sleep Preparation and Contacting Parents
description: After urging my daughter to wash up and go to bed, I had my daily routine video call with my parents, who are far away in Quanzhou. I inquired about my father’s leg condition, shared amusing stories about my daughter, and updated them on my baking results from the evening, striving to keep the conversation light and pleasant.
location: In the bedroom of Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Personal Hygiene and Bedtime
description: Complete personal grooming and skincare routine. Reflect on the day: shop operations are back on track, preliminary plans for spring procurement are in place, rent has been paid, and family time was warm and fulfilling. Fall asleep with a sense of slight fatigue but contentment.
location: In the bathroom and bedroom of the Shanggu Street residential area, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Waking up in the morning and saying goodbye to the family.
description: The alarm went off at 5:30 a.m. Song Yajing quietly got up and washed up, double-checked her backpack (ID, power bank, shopping notebook, Xiamen pineapple cakes), kissed her sleeping daughter Xuanxuan, whispered goodbye to her husband Aqiang, and left home with her suitcase.
location: At home in Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province

description:
After her daughter fell asleep, Song Yajing went to the kitchen to start preparing food for the weekend picnic. She prepared slices of whole wheat bread, layered them with cheese, ham, and lettuce to make several sandwiches, and carefully wrapped them in plastic wrap. Next, she thoroughly washed strawberries, blueberries, and cherry tomatoes, patted them dry with kitchen paper, and placed them in airtight containers. Her husband, Aqiang, came over to help, retrieving the picnic mat and utensils and setting them aside.  

Afterward, she attempted to bake a French lemon tart. She took out the recipe shared by Master Chen and the ingredients she had purchased, following the steps to make the tart crust and lemon curd before baking it to set. Throughout the process, she remained fully focused, while her husband, Aqiang, occasionally checked in to offer encouragement.  

Once the lemon tart was out of the oven, it had a golden hue and emitted a refreshing lemon aroma. After letting it cool slightly, she carefully arranged it on a plate, took a photo, and shared it in a WeChat baking group with Master Chen, her baking teacher, and neighbors like Mrs. Liu. Soon, she received likes and compliments, with Master Chen replying, "It looks like a great success!" This filled Song Yajing with immense satisfaction and joy.  

Later, she followed her evening skincare routine and said her bedtime prayers. Around 11:30 p.m., she fell asleep with a sense of accomplishment.

Bright summer outfits were combined and matched to replace the dull styles, with Xiaomei assisting and offering suggestions. During the adjustments, I attended to occasional regular customers. After completing the changes, photos were taken for online promotion.  

At noon, in the store’s rest area, I called supplier Susan to discuss the decline in foot traffic and rumors of renovations, exploring promotional strategies and identifying potential traffic-driving products. The call lasted about 25 minutes. Afterward, Xiaomei and I took turns for lunch. Song Yajing went to Hongwen Wuli Rice Noodle Roll Fast Food Restaurant for lunch. While eating, I received a reply from Mrs. Liu with a link to her tea bag micro-store and bookmarked it.  

In the afternoon, foot traffic remained low. While keeping an eye on customers, I used the computer to handle online tasks: responding to inquiries, posting display photos on social media and community groups, and browsing wholesale websites for inspiration. Throughout the day, I continued to feel anxious about the decline in foot traffic.

name: Returning to Xiamen Island under the night sky.

We took the night ferry back to Xiamen Ferry Terminal (opposite Zhongshan Road) and stood at the stern, gazing back at the lights of Gulangyu. We retrieved the car from the parking lot near the pier, and Chen Zhiqiang drove us back to Shanggu Street Community. The roads were clear and smooth at night.

Sitting on the sofa, we tried on each other's gifts, expressing our delight and sharing a small piece of cake. Later, Song Yajing used her phone to send a WeChat message to Xu Wei, the owner of the cultural and creative store she met at last night's salon, expressing her intention to collaborate and maintain contact.
location: In the living room of the Shanggu Street residential area, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, China.

Talk about picking up their daughter Xuanxuan next week and look forward to a family trip to Europe when the child is a bit older.
location: In the living room of the Shanggu Street residential area, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province.

name: Washing up before bed and saying goodnight to each other.

Lying in bed, Chen Zhiqiang and I exchanged wishes of "Happy 10th Anniversary," expressing gratitude for ten years of companionship, support, and love. I drifted into a peaceful sleep filled with a sense of happiness.

She then prepared breakfast (toast, fried eggs, and milk) with her husband, Chen Zhiqiang. After that, she checked the three large boxes of pastries (macarons, pound cake, and low-sugar cookies) prepared for the charity sale, confirmed that the packaging was intact, and placed them in an insulated bag. Her husband checked the car’s fuel level. She felt both nervous and excited.

We carefully arranged the setup: laying out a checkered tablecloth, displaying macarons on tiered stands, plating pound cakes, neatly arranging low-sugar cookies, and assisting in hanging the charity sale promotional posters.

description: The charity sale officially began, and Song Yajing's pastries quickly attracted a crowd due to their exquisite appearance. She enthusiastically introduced her products, particularly recommending the low-sugar series to middle-aged and elderly church members. The macarons sold out within half an hour. Her husband assisted with collecting payments and packaging. She exchanged greetings with many church members, shared baking tips, and received numerous compliments. She stood and served for about four hours, feeling joyful throughout.

description: At 13:00, I drove with my husband and several fellow church members to the Sili Shacha Noodle Shop. We arrived at 13:10 and placed our orders (Song Yajing ordered Shacha noodles with tofu and squid). While eating, we excitedly discussed the success of the charity sale that morning, with Song Yajing’s pastries being highly praised and becoming the focus of the conversation. The lunch was simple but filled with a joyful atmosphere of sharing.

description: At 14:00, I drove back to the church to help handle the remaining pastries (which were almost completely sold out). The charity sale was nearing its end, and Father Wang Mingde summarized the event, specifically acknowledging Song Yajing for her exquisite pastries and dedication, which was met with applause. Afterwards, I counted the funds raised at the baking stall with Aunt Lin, and the amount far exceeded expectations. Song Yajing felt deeply moved and proud.
location: No. 200 Datong Road, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province, within the courtyard of Siming Catholic Church and in front of the main church.

name: Driving back home, resting, and preparing for work.
description: At 15:30, I drove home and, on the way, discussed the highlights of the charity sale in detail with my husband. At 16:00, after arriving home, I took a hot shower to wash away the fatigue, changed into comfortable home clothes, and relaxed with a glass of lemon water. To prepare for tomorrow's (June 30) afternoon phone conference with the supplier Susan, I went to the study, turned on the computer, quickly reviewed the autumn market trends report, and jotted down several key discussion points in my notebook.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Shanggu Street Community (near Hubin South Road), living room/study at home

description: Contact my daughter Xuanxuan and my mother Lin Xiuying, who are at our maternal home in Quanzhou, via WeChat video. Have Xuanxuan show the painting she drew today and listen to her share interesting stories. Then, tell them about the great success of today's charity sale, mentioning that the priest even praised Mom. Xuanxuan happily claps her hands, and Mother also praises repeatedly.

name: Family Dinner Celebrating the Success of the Charity Sale
description: To celebrate the success of the charity sale, the couple ordered dishes such as ginger duck and oyster omelets from a nearby Fujian restaurant through a food delivery app. At the dinner table, Song Yajing shared more detailed feedback from the church members, along with her vague idea of developing baking into a small side business. Her husband listened attentively and felt proud of her.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Shanggu Street Community (near Hubin South Road), Home Restaurant

name: Community walk after meals
description: After dinner, my husband and I went downstairs for a walk around the neighborhood and the nearby community park to aid digestion. The evening breeze was cool and refreshing. Walking hand in hand, our conversation naturally flowed from today's charity sale to the sweetness of yesterday's (June 28) tenth anniversary celebration, as well as the sense of relief we felt after completing the rental process for our old house.
location: Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (near Hubin South Road) and the surrounding community park

It was decided that Song Yajing and her husband would drive to Quanzhou to pick her up on the morning of the 3rd, bringing some Xiamen specialties along the way, and return after having lunch in Quanzhou. Mother reminded them to drive safely.
location: Shanggu Street Community, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (near Hubin South Road), living room at home

name: Evening Leisure and Recording
description: Check out fashion updates and baking recipe videos. Briefly jot down today's events in the phone memo: from the anticipation of the early morning, to the liveliness of the charity sale, the priest's praise, the surprise of the donations, and then the warmth of sharing with family. Specifically noted "the sense of community connection and value brought by baking."
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Shanggu Street Community (near Hubin South Road), living room/study at home

name: Bedtime washing and preparation for tomorrow
description: Perform the evening washing and skincare routine. Prepare the clothes to wear for opening the shop the next day (Monday).

name: Go to bed and rest.
description: Turn off the lights and rest, ending this day filled with dedication, recognition, and family warmth. The mood is one of immense accomplishment, value, and belonging, with the happiness brought by having skills widely recognized by the community being indescribable. Today’s exercise mainly consisted of standing service for about 4 hours at the charity sale and walking approximately 2,000 steps.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Shanggu Street Community (near Hubin South Road), own bedroom

name: Morning Family Preparation and Breakfast
description: Song Yajing woke up at 06:15, feeling a slight soreness in her body from yesterday's charity sale. After washing up, she prepared a simple breakfast (fried egg toast and hot milk) in the kitchen while opening the weather app on her phone to check the typhoon "Lotus" warning. She had breakfast with her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, discussing the day's store inventory review arrangements and the typhoon updates. After the meal, she tidied up the kitchen, changed into casual office attire, picked up her commuter bag, and decided to drive to work.

name: Drive to the store.
description: Song Yajing drove from the Shanggu Street residential area to Ruijing Commercial Plaza via West Lianqian Road. The morning rush hour traffic was manageable, and she arrived at the parking lot in about 25 minutes. During the journey, she listened to the local traffic radio broadcast and once again heard the typhoon warning alert.

name: The store operates in the morning and during work hours.
description: After arriving at the store, Song Yajing and the staff member Xiaomei began preparing for the day: cleaning the glass door, wiping down the display counters, and organizing the checkout area. During a break, she reviewed her visual merchandising course notes, adjusted the mannequin display at the entrance (pairing a linen dress with a straw bag), and asked Xiaomei for customer feedback. Xiaomei mentioned that some younger customers had praised the outfit. After the store opened, Song Yajing attended to occasional customers. During quieter moments, she sorted through the June sales records, preliminarily organized receipts, and cross-checked orders from the online micro-store, preparing some data for the monthly financial review. During this time, she also had a brief video call with her daughter Xuanxuan, who is in Quanzhou, via WeChat.

name: In-store lunch and lunch break
description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei ordered Minnan braised pork rice and daily soup from "Hongwen Wuli" through a food delivery app, and dined in the restaurant's lounge area. The two chatted casually. After the meal, Song Yajing leaned back on the sofa, closed her eyes, and rested for 15 minutes for a midday nap.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Ruijing Commercial Plaza Specialty Store (Rest Area Inside "Yajing" Boutique Clothing Store)

name: Centralize and organize financial data.
description: In the relatively quiet afternoon, Song Yajing focused on processing the expense receipts for June (including purchase orders, courier fees, utilities, and miscellaneous expenses), categorizing them and entering the data into an Excel spreadsheet. At the same time, she summarized the sales data from the morning to calculate the approximate gross income and total expenses for the month, completing the preparation for the monthly financial review. Around 3 p.m., she paused her work to prepare for a conference call with suppliers, listing the questions that needed confirmation.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Ruijing Commercial Plaza Specialty Store (Office Area inside "Yajing" Boutique Clothing Store)

description: Song Yajing held a timely conference call with the supplier Susan to delve into the specific details of the autumn ordering meeting. Song Yajing took notes on key points and reached agreements in her notebook, ultimately finalizing the preliminary direction for product selection.
location: Specialty Store, Ruijing Commercial Plaza, Siming District, Xiamen City, Fujian Province (Office Area inside "Yajing" Boutique Clothing Store)

She then assisted Xiaomei in tidying up the sales floor, returning clothes that had been tried on by customers to their proper places. At the same time, she printed out the sales data sheet and expense summary needed for the evening review, preparing for the monthly business review meeting.

description: After closing the shop, Song Yajing and Xiaomei worked together to take stock of all the inventory. Xiaomei was responsible for reporting the style numbers and quantities according to the shelves, while Song Yajing checked and recorded the actual quantities in the computer inventory system, specifically marking the best-selling items and slow-moving styles. Once the inventory count was completed, they conducted a brief summary. Song Yajing thanked Xiaomei for her help and pointed out that summer dresses had sold the best, but the inventory for some basic T-shirts was relatively high.

name: Monthly Business Review Meeting and End of Work
description: Song Yajing and Xiaomei held a monthly business review meeting in the rest area, analyzing the net profit and profit margin for June, setting sales targets for July, planning the marketing budget (deciding to try Xiaohongshu promotion), and discussing funding arrangements for the autumn ordering meeting. Xiaomei contributed suggestions from the sales frontline. After the meeting, Song Yajing recorded the key points, turned off the main power supply in the store, locked the door, bid farewell to Xiaomei, and drove away.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Siming District, Ruijing Commercial Plaza Specialty Store (Rest Area and Parking Lot inside "Yajing" Boutique Clothing Store)

As they ate, Song Yajing updated her husband on the shop’s review and discussed typhoon preparedness measures in detail: they checked the balcony doors and windows, confirmed the availability of emergency supplies, and put away the purchased items. Song Yajing also sent a WeChat message to her parents in Quanzhou, reminding them to stay safe.

Next, she transferred the photos and videos from her phone commemorating the 10th anniversary of her relationship (June 28) to her laptop. After quickly browsing through them, she created a new folder to store a few particularly cherished ones, savoring the warmth of the anniversary day.

After that, she put down her phone and spent time playing a puzzle game with her daughter, balancing work and family life.

She decided to wrap up her other tasks early and shift into caregiving mode: administering children’s cold medicine to her daughter, gently wiping her face, hands, and feet with warm water to help with physical cooling. Her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, joined in after washing the dishes, and together they read picture books with their daughter. Later, Song Yajing soothed her daughter to sleep, softly humming a lullaby until she drifted off peacefully.

name: Pre-sleep Communication and Organization

She sent a message in the family WeChat group to thank her mother for picking up their daughter the next day, informed them about her daughter's cold, and reminded her husband. She also sent a separate WeChat message to the shop assistant, Xiaomei, to encourage her. Afterward, she checked the luggage and documents for the next day's trip to ensure everything was in order, then washed up and applied skincare. Due to her daughter's illness, she canceled her entertainment plans and went to bed early. Lying in bed, she reflected on the day, prayed for her family's health and a safe journey, and then fell asleep.

name: Wake up in the morning and bid farewell to the family.
description: Song Yajing got up at 06:00, washed up, and finally checked her luggage for the business trip to ensure that her ID card, work items, and local specialties were all in place. She then had a simple breakfast with her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, during which she reminded her daughter to take care of things at home and handle online matters for the store. They bid each other a warm farewell, reflecting family responsibilities and affection.

name: Drive to Xiamen North Station and hand over the daughter to the mother.
description: Chen Zhiqiang drove an SUV to take Song Yajing and their daughter Chen Lexuan to Xiamen North Railway Station. During the journey, Song Yajing contacted the store staff to arrange work at the shop. Upon arrival, they met with Lin Xiuying, Song Yajing’s mother, who had arrived by high-speed train from Quanzhou, on the departure level. They handed over the care of their daughter, including clothes, a water bottle, and medication, and bid farewell as a family to ensure their daughter would be well taken care of.
location: Fujian Province, Xiamen City, Huli District, Xiamen North Station Departure Level Drop-off Area and Entrance Vicinity

name: Security Check Waiting and Train Boarding
description: Song Yajing passed through security at Xiamen North Station, bought mineral water and a fashion magazine in the waiting hall, and boarded the G1601 train at 08:15 after ticket inspection. description: On the G1601 train, Song Yajing focused on preparing for work: reviewing the autumn fashion trends report, analyzing the store's customer base, identifying knitwear, dresses, and trousers as key procurement items, drafting a budget allocation, and simulating negotiation strategies with supplier Susan. At noon, she had lunch and observed passengers' outfits for fashion inspiration. After the meal, she rested for half an hour. Before arrival, she freshened up her makeup and organized her belongings, preparing for her afternoon arrival in Guangzhou.

She then confirmed the meeting time and general location for the next day with her supplier, Susan, via WeChat. Following that, she contacted her husband, Chen Zhiqiang, to inform him of her safe arrival and to inquire about their daughter's recovery. Afterwards, she took some personal time to freshen up, browse fashion information online, and change into an outfit suitable for her evening outing.
location: Guangzhou Hotel Rooms and Lobby, No. 2 Qiyi Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province

location: Room, Guangzhou Hotel, No. 2 Qiyi Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province

Afterward, she set the alarm for the next day, checked the security of the door, turned off the lights, and went to bed, ensuring she had enough energy for the important work ahead.

Afterward, tidy up appearance, change into a beige linen shirt and black cropped pants, check items like notebook, pen, power bank, sample bag, calculator, and shopping list, send a WeChat message to the shop assistant Xiaomei to inquire about the store situation and remind her to operate as usual, and finally, apply perfume to boost spirits.

We took photos of the sample garments and tag information with our phones. At the same time, we observed the outfits of other buyers to gather inspiration.

Susan shared sales feedback.

I noticed that the use of colors was bolder compared to Xiamen, and I made a mental note of it.

description: In the reception room of Susan Company at Dabo Plaza Office Building, in-depth negotiations were conducted. Detailed discussions were held on each item of interest from the morning's selection. Leveraging a thorough understanding of the market and clear accounting, negotiations were firmly pursued on price, minimum order quantity, colors, and delivery timelines. After nearly three and a half hours of communication, both parties finally reached an agreement on the first batch of orders for the autumn season, successfully securing more favorable tiered pricing and a commitment to prioritized production. Following this, the formal procurement contract was reviewed and signed, and a handshake celebrated the successful outcome.

At the same time, upon seeing the canelé, I was reminded of my side business plan for baking.
